archetypes.name: state-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 18 state rewrites have schema, ordering, and sentinel invariants that merit targeted plan-vs-evidence review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the plan’s proposed stall state mutations match the existing state-file contract, helper idioms, and stall-recovery prose. Check for gaps around canonical keys, key preservation, symlink or malformed-state handling, disk-before-memory ordering, and the promised CLEARED/SEEDED machine outputs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: emit-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The final-report wrapper changes prompt-side versus script-side responsibilities where double-emit or missing-emit defects are easy to introduce.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the Step 18b extraction preserves the existing final-report emission boundary and sentinel semantics across SKILL.md, wrapper contract, and tests. Pay special attention to .step17-emitted versus .step17-printed naming, dropped --print-stdout behavior, failure handling, and whether any plan step would make bash emit body text that must remain prompt-side. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-integration
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds and registers new harnesses, so Makefile shards, docs, lint pins, and existing regression contracts need consistency review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed test additions and Makefile registration cover every new helper contract without drifting from existing harness conventions. Check that named test files, sibling markdown docs, lint commands, shard coverage, structural-pin preservation, and existing write-final-report coverage line up with the repository’s current patterns. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
